text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — final run for CloudCon joint webinar next Thurs. Need speaker order, who pre-records, who ships hardware kits, and swag-bundle lead. Also confirm rehearsal window :wave:
Kevin Patel: I can own speaker queue + pre-records. Will call for 10-min talks (6 speakers). I’ll make a shared slide master. Who has bios?
Lia Gomez: I’ll coordinate swag with Orbit Labs & Nova — shipping labels ready. We should do 40 attendee bundles (sticker pack, partner one-pager, cable). Any dietary notes for on-site snacks?
Tony Rivera: Hardware demos: I’ll bring 1 demo rig + 2 loaner GPUs. Plan B: recorded walkthrough of benchmark if live demo fails. Need someone to SSH in and swap model weights if endpoint dies.
Raj Singh: I’ll be on-call for demo hot-swap and ssh. Put me in runbook and give me remote VPN + jump host creds. Also suggest we stage a pre-cached KV for demos to avoid cold-starts.
Olivia Park: ops-bot scheduled rehearsal reminder: rehearsal set for 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. Rehearsal link -> https://meet.redwood.ai/cloudcon-rehearsal
Kevin Patel: @Lia can you confirm swag contents by Friday? I want to include a 1-page QR card with the demo repo + sample prompts.
Lia Gomez: Yes — final list by Fri EOD. Also partnering SIs want co-branded label for the kit. Do we want to include a short instruction insert for hardware loaners?
Tony Rivera: Yes, include quick start (power + network LED checks). Put contact line: support@redwood.ai and hotline for event.
Maria Chen: Run-of-show draft — quick sketch below. Please flag changes.
Maria Chen: ```
10:00 Setup/AV check
10:20 Welcome + 3min intros
10:25 Rapid lightning talks (6 x 10min)
11:25 Short break / swag raffle
11:35 Hands-on showcase (3 partners, 12min each) + live Q&A
12:15 Closing + CTA + post-event survey link
```
Kevin Patel: For lightning talks I'd like to swap order: SI partner first, then hardware, then Redwood. Gives a better escalation to the hands-on.
Raj Singh: Agree. Also recommend we reserve a small timebox (~6 mins) between each hands-on to handle handoffs (network issues, demo resets).
Lia Gomez: Shipping question — do we send swag directly to partners to hand out, or to Redwood to redistribute at booth? Cost & customs differ.
Maria Chen: Let's do mixed: local EU partners get direct ship; US we centralize to Redwood for quality check. Lia pls share a PO list.
Olivia Park: ops-bot: vendor-sla reminder — all international shipments should have tracking + insurance.
Tony Rivera: AV notes: bring a backup HDMI encoder, and 1 USB-C to HDMI adapter per rig. If partner wants to present via their laptop, we need USB-C passthrough checked 15 min early.
Kevin Patel: Who’s recording? Need separate attendee-facing recording + partner-only raw feed. I can take attendee recording, but who captures partner raw?
Raj Singh: I’ll capture partner raw on a local machine and upload to S3 after. Add post-event TO-DO: verify uploads + delete PII logs.
Lia Gomez: Raffle & swag flow: we’ll do 1 digital raffle (survey+email) and 5 speaker-curated VIP bundles. Need legal ok for giveaway in EU — copying legal after this thread.
Maria Chen: Action items: Kevin — slide master & bios by Thu. Lia — swag packing list + shipping plan by Fri. Tony — demo checklist + spare adapters by Wed. Raj — runbook access + backup capture plan by Wed. I’ll coordinate rehearsal confirmations.
Olivia Park: ops-bot: rehearsal reminder 2026-04-14 10:00 PT, 1 hour before final check-in 09:00 PT. Automated check: "Are all speakers present?" DM to hosts.
Kevin Patel: All good here. I’ll ping everyone with the slide folder in 1 hour. :thumbsup:
Lia Gomez: Shipping labels queued. Will DM carriers and post tracking numbers in #logistics channel.
Maria Chen: Thanks team — this feels tight but doable. Let’s aim to close all items by Friday EOD. :rocket:
